2610.12248.title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
2610.12248.paper_summary: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.
2610.12248.paper_summary_zh: 可穿戴的增強現實（AR）助手正朝著持續的現實世界互動發展，這些助手通過第一人稱視頻和音頻感知用戶的活動，並在未被明確要求的情況下提供及時的口頭指導。雖然主動視頻助手、口語對話系統和自我中心任務理解各自都取得了快速進展，但現有系統並未解決從連續的第一人稱流中決定何時發言和說什麼的聯合問題。我們介紹了EgoVoice，這是一個用於訓練和評估主動自我中心口語助手的框架。從HoloAssist的真實人類講師視頻錄製中，我們通過源分離和語音重合成構建乾淨的音頻流，並將每個視頻會話轉換為一種格式，在這種格式中，模型必須在每個時刻決定是保持沉默還是提供口頭指導。我們使用我們的數據對全模態LLM進行微調，並通過直接偏好優化進一步改善其主動干預行為。針對封閉和開源模型的實驗顯示，現有系統很少能夠產生時機良好、意義深遠的主動干預，而EgoVoice在干預時機、內容相關性和人類偏好方面相較於零樣本基礎模型顯示出明顯的改進。
2610.12248.author: Heeseung Kim et.al.
